title: 6th Order Point Mass (Coordinated Flight)
text: Calculate sixth-order point mass in coordinated flight, 3 inputs, 6 outputs, {Initial mass} sets Point mass; {Units}, {Initial flight path angle}, {Initial heading angle}, {Initial airspeed}, {Initial downrange [East]}, {Initial crossrange [North]} sets the initial cross range and {Initial altitude [Up]}. Values come from the instance.
